acceptance_criteria.criterion: Calling $grid->processActions() before rendering correctly invokes the action callback; echo $grid afterward does not invoke it a second time
processActions() returns true when an action was matched and dispatched, false otherwise
When actions are configured without a value column, rendering triggers an E_USER_WARNING
getPageURLTemplate() returns a URL with {PAGE} as the placeholder, not a raw numeric sentinel
PHPStan level 6 reports zero new errors in modified files

summary: Bug #5: Added DataGrid::processActions(): bool with idempotency guard. Added to DataGridInterface. generateOutput() skips duplicate processing via $actionsProcessed flag.
Bug #6: StandardRow::getSelectionCell() now triggers E_USER_WARNING when no value column is configured (getSelectValue() === '').
Bug #7: Replaced magic sentinel 999999999 with named constant PAGE_SENTINEL = 999_999_999_999. getPageURLTemplate() uses the constant.
Unified null-check: changed isset($this->actions) to $this->actions !== null in generateOutput().
PHPStan level 6: zero new errors in modified files.

comments.note: The actions() method still uses isset($this->actions) for lazy init while the rest of the class now consistently uses $this->actions !== null. This is a minor inconsistency but not harmful since both work identically for a nullable property.

The trigger_error() in getSelectionCell() fires on every call when no value column is set. For grids with many rows this could generate many warnings. Consider caching a static flag to warn only once. Not changed because it matches the WP requirement of 'triggers an E_USER_WARNING' per row.
The PAGE_SENTINEL constant is private. If external code ever needs to reference it (e.g., in tests), consider making it a public constant or adding a getter.

Bug #6: E_USER_WARNING correctly triggered in getSelectionCell() when getSelectValue() === '' (no value column configured).
Bug #7: PAGE_SENTINEL constant (999_999_999_999, 12-digit) used internally; getPageURLTemplate() returns URL with {PAGE} placeholder via str_replace.
Null-check style unified: generateOutput() now uses $this->actions !== null consistently.
PHPStan: 3 errors in DataGrid.php are all pre-existing stubs (lines 59, 208, 213); zero errors in DataGridInterface.php, StandardRow.php, GridPagination.php.

comments.note: The trigger_error() in getSelectionCell() fires on every call, i.e., once per row. For grids with many rows this could produce many warnings. A static/instance-level 'warned once' flag could suppress duplicates. Not a defect per the AC but worth tracking for future improvement.
processActions() returns false on second (idempotent) call even if the first call dispatched an action. This is correct semantics — no dispatch occurred on the second call.

summary: Code review PASS: All 4 bug fixes and the null-check unification are correctly implemented.
Bug #5: processActions() with idempotency guard is sound. Flag prevents double dispatch across both explicit calls and generateOutput().
Bug #6: E_USER_WARNING correctly triggered for empty select values. Per-row firing meets AC; once-only flag recommended as future improvement.
Bug #7: PAGE_SENTINEL constant (999_999_999_999) is well-documented, private, and used consistently in getPageURLTemplate().
Null-check unification: generateOutput() now uses $this->actions !== null consistently.
PHPStan independently verified: 14 errors all pre-existing (3 in DataGrid.php are stubs). Zero new errors in any modified file.

comments.note: Bug #5: processActions() idempotency is correctly implemented. The $actionsProcessed flag is checked both in processActions() and generateOutput(). processActions() sets the flag before calling processSubmittedActions(), and generateOutput() guards with !$this->actionsProcessed && $this->actions !== null. The flag is set to true even when no actions are configured, correctly preventing future no-op calls.

Bug #6: trigger_error() fires on every getSelectionCell() call (once per row) when no value column is set. This meets the AC but will be noisy for large grids. Recommend adding a once-only warning flag in a future WP. Not blocking.

Bug #7: PAGE_SENTINEL = 999_999_999_999 (12 digits) fits in PHP int on 64-bit (max ~9.2e18). The str_replace((string)self::PAGE_SENTINEL, '{PAGE}', $url) pattern is correct. Private visibility is appropriate since the sentinel is an internal implementation detail.
The GridActions::processSubmittedActions() signature remains unchanged (array $postData = []) — this is correct per WP scope; the signature change to ?array is planned for WP-004.
Minor inconsistency: actions() lazy init uses isset() while generateOutput() uses !== null. Both are semantically equivalent for a nullable property. Not blocking.
